expectations.text: Rejects the 50-partner target as unachievable from zero supply in 10 weeks and says so plainly rather than hedging
expectations.evidence: Bottom line opens: '"At least 50 partners on stage" cannot be met honestly in 10 weeks. Nessforth has no apps, no reviewer and no pipeline.' The 'Why 50 fails' section backs this up ('10 weeks supports single digits, not 50') and recommends a 3-6 cohort with the 50 reframed as a roadmap. Option 2 offers a '50 logos' slide, but it is labeled 'building on the API' and flagged as risky, so the rejection still stands.

expectations.text: Rejects the 50-partner target as unachievable from zero supply in 10 weeks and says so plainly rather than hedging
expectations.evidence: The answer opens with a bolded line: "'50 partners on stage' can't be 50 shipped, reviewed apps. Reset the number this week." It backs this with zero apps, no reviewer and no pipeline, plus a 4–6 week build time, and gives a concrete realistic figure of 10–15 live apps. It also says the 50-logo wall is reachable only if unshipped partners are labeled "Coming soon". It gives a next action: meet the VP to reframe the target. The rejection is direct and not hedged.
